name: Dimension Equalities for Matroid Flat Classes
statement: For every finite matroid $M$ of rank $r$, over every coefficient field, $\operatorname{intdeg}(\mathcal H_M)=\operatorname{VC}(\mathcal H_M)=\operatorname{hd}(\mathcal H_M)=r$; the shattered coordinate sets are exactly the independent sets of $M$.
proof: Independence is equivalent to shattering by flats. Interval Cohen--Macaulayness of the geometric lattice gives the Yang-dimension upper bound, and minimum generators of flats are bases of restrictions, giving interpolation degree $r$.
